title: POTV Recycler Glass Bubbler
description:
The POTV Recycler Bubbler

Discover the coolest vaping experience with our POTV Recycler Bubbler, designed to elevate your sessions with the smoothest hits. This bubbler features our Max Purity percolator for the deepest filtration and a second recycler chamber for extra cooling.

A bubbler isn’t just an accessory; it’s a game-changer for those who seek smoother, more flavorful sessions. Connect your compatible dry herb vaporizer to a bubbler and enjoy the strongest hits with a gentle touch.

Why POTV Glass?

Experience unparalleled vaping with POTV bubblers—your ticket to smoother, cleaner hits that pack a punch. Crafted with care and expert insight, every piece in our collection is tested and refined by vape specialists to meet our high standards. We work directly with glassmakers to give you the best price on glass pieces that work in tandem with your vape setup.

Choose POTV for a bubbler that matches your style perfectly. With multiple designs tailored for different vape styles, our premium glass pieces are made to be fun AND effective additions to your sessions.

Maximum cooling with fun Recycler action

Inhale bigger, cooler hits with our POTV Recycler Bubbler. Designed with our Max Purity percolator, this bubbler features dozens of little holes for wide-open airflow, maximum filtration, and a recycler chamber that filters your vapor even further.

14mm connection

Connect any 14mm male adapter to our POTV Recycler Bubbler, including our POTV Water Pipe Adapter.

Vaporizers that are compatible with our POTV Water Pipe Adapter:

POTV Lobo
POTV ONE
POTV XMAX V3 Pro
XMAX V3 Pro + POTV Adapter
PAX Plus, PAX Mini, PAX 2, PAX 3 + POTV PAX Adapter.
Mighty+ + Mighty+ Glass Adapter.
Crafty+ + Crafty+ Glass Adapter.
Volcano Hybrid, Volcano Classic + Volcano Glass Adapter

High-quality glass

Our POTV Glass Bubblers are constructed from high-quality borosilicate glass for the purest, cleanest hits.

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.
